features.feature_summary: The Transcoder v1 API is the new stable API version introduced for Google Cloud Transcoder.
features.extended_definition: The Transcoder v1 API is the new stable API version introduced for Google Cloud Transcoder.

features.feature_summary: The Transcoder v1beta1 API is the original (legacy) version of Google Cloud Transcoder that is being retired and replaced by the v1 API; deprecated on 2021-07-13.
features.extended_definition: The Transcoder v1beta1 API is the original (legacy) version of Google Cloud Transcoder that is being retired and replaced by the v1 API; deprecated on 2021-07-13.

features.feature_summary: Transcoder API added beta-stage support for operating under VPC Service Controls.
features.extended_definition: Transcoder API added beta-stage support for operating under VPC Service Controls.

features.feature_summary: Sprite sheet generation now preserves source aspect ratio by auto-calculating one dimension when only sprite width or height is provided.
features.extended_definition: Sprite sheet generation now preserves source aspect ratio by auto-calculating one dimension when only sprite width or height is provided.

features.feature_summary: Sprite sheets now support selectable image compression levels via a quality setting.
features.extended_definition: Sprite sheets now support selectable image compression levels via a quality setting.

features.feature_summary: Transcoder API now supports padding videos with black.
features.extended_definition: Transcoder API now supports padding videos with black.

features.feature_summary: Added support in Transcoder API for AES-128 content protection for HLS and DASH outputs in fMP4 and TS containers.
features.extended_definition: Added support in Transcoder API for AES-128 content protection for HLS and DASH outputs in fMP4 and TS containers.

features.feature_name: Cloud SDK support for Transcoder API
features.feature_summary: The Cloud SDK added support for interacting with the Transcoder API.
features.extended_definition: The Cloud SDK added support for interacting with the Transcoder API.

features.feature_summary: Transcoder API now supports cropping in media transcoding workflows.
features.extended_definition: Transcoder API now supports cropping in media transcoding workflows.

features.feature_summary: Added support in Transcoder API for FairPlay content encryption using SAMPLE-AES in HLS TS and HLS fMP4 outputs.
features.extended_definition: Added support in Transcoder API for FairPlay content encryption using SAMPLE-AES in HLS TS and HLS fMP4 outputs.

features.feature_summary: Transcoder API now supports overlays in transcoded outputs.
features.extended_definition: Transcoder API now supports overlays in transcoded outputs.

features.feature_name: Shaka player DASH and HLS CEA608/CEA708 support
features.feature_summary: Added Shaka player compatibility for DASH and HLS streams using CEA-608/CEA-708 captioning.
features.extended_definition: Added Shaka player compatibility for DASH and HLS streams using CEA-608/CEA-708 captioning.

features.feature_summary: Transcoder API now preserves the original source video's aspect ratio during transcoding.
features.extended_definition: Transcoder API now preserves the original source video's aspect ratio during transcoding.

features.feature_summary: Released updated client libraries for the Transcoder API.
features.extended_definition: Released updated client libraries for the Transcoder API.

features.feature_summary: Added support in Transcoder API for Widevine and PlayReady content encryption using MPEG-CENC for DASH fMP4 outputs.
features.extended_definition: Added support in Transcoder API for Widevine and PlayReady content encryption using MPEG-CENC for DASH fMP4 outputs.

features.feature_summary: Added support in Transcoder API for Widevine and PlayReady content encryption using MPEG-CENC for HLS fMP4 outputs.
features.extended_definition: Added support in Transcoder API for Widevine and PlayReady content encryption using MPEG-CENC for HLS fMP4 outputs.
